title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Seriously Studying and Implementing the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the General Provisions of the Contract Book of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Diligently Studying and Implementing the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the General Principles of the Contract Part of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China

Fa [2023] No. 239

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the General Principles of the Contract Part of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as "the Interpretation") came into effect on December 5, 2023. In order to correctly apply the Interpretation in trial work, notice is hereby given on the relevant issues concerning the study and implementation of the Interpretation as follows:

I. Fully Recognizing the Significance of the Promulgation of the Interpretation

The effective implementation of the Contract Part of the Civil Code is of great significance for developing the socialist market economy within the framework of the rule of law and consolidating the basic socialist economic system. Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, adhering to the principles of putting the people first, adopting a problem-oriented approach, employing systematic thinking, and upholding fundamental principles while breaking new ground, the Interpretation, based on the provisions of the Civil Code and judicial practice, and following extensive consultation with all parties, stipulates rules on difficult issues that have long troubled civil and commercial adjudication. The promulgation of the Interpretation plays an important role in correctly and effectively implementing the Civil Code, unifying judicial reasoning, regulating judges' discretion, enhancing the people's courts' ability to substantively resolve disputes, focusing on the work theme of "justice and efficiency," stabilizing social expectations of judicial decisions, guiding parties to voluntarily resolve disputes through consultation before litigation, promoting pro-active judicial work in the new era, and advancing high-quality economic development. To enable people's courts at all levels to promptly and accurately understand and grasp the spirit and content of the Contract Part of the Civil Code and the Interpretation, and to correctly understand and apply them in case adjudication, the people's courts at all levels shall, while properly balancing work and study, organize learning and training through various forms and carry out publicity work.

II. Accurately Grasping the Temporal Effect of the Interpretation

Article 69(2) of the Interpretation stipulates whether the Interpretation applies to civil cases arising from legal facts occurring after the implementation of the Civil Code. For civil cases arising from legal facts occurring before the implementation of the Civil Code, in accordance with the provisions of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Temporal Effect of the Application of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, if the provisions of the General Principles of the Contract Part of the Civil Code have retroactive effect, then the Interpretation's stipulations regarding the application of such provisions shall also have retroactive effect. In addition, if a case under trial should apply the provisions of the original Contract Law, and the Civil Code has not substantially modified those provisions, after the implementation of the Interpretation, when hearing cases at first instance and on appeal, the people's courts may, in the "Opinion of the Court" section of the judgment document, cite the Interpretation's understanding of such provisions as the basis for judicial reasoning.

III. Regarding the Application of the Doctrine of Change of Circumstances

After Article 26 of the former Interpretation (II) of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the "Contract Law Interpretation II") established the doctrine of change of circumstances, the Supreme People's Court issued the Notice on Correctly Applying the Interpretation (II) of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China to Serve the Overall Work of the Party and the State (Fa [2009] No. 165), requiring people's courts at all levels to apply the doctrine of change of circumstances with caution. Where application in individual cases is truly necessary due to special circumstances of the case, it shall be reviewed by the High People's Court; if necessary, it shall be reported to the Supreme People's Court for review. Considering that Article 533 of the Civil Code has already clearly stipulated the doctrine of change of circumstances, after the implementation of the Interpretation, the above-mentioned review system shall no longer apply. People's courts at all levels shall correctly understand the provisions of the Civil Code and the Interpretation regarding the doctrine of change of circumstances and properly handle the relationship between achieving fairness in individual cases and maintaining contract stability.

December 19, 2023
